notes: 501(c)(3) volunteer, home-based NYC wildlife-mammal group. IMPORTANT: currently ON HIATUS from active rehabilitation per its own site - serves mainly as an information resource. Kept in the file because its Local Rehabbers page is a genuinely useful by-species, by-county NYC-area rehabber directory. Note UUWR documents that there are NO NYC-licensed rehabbers for raccoons, skunks or bats (Rabies Vector Species) - those go to surrounding counties via the DEC list; for RVS in the city call 311 / Urban Park Rangers.
